name: iplweb-claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills for Python and DevOps workflows

plugins.name: django-extract-app
plugins.description: Audits a Django app inside a monolithic project for extractability and extracts it into a standalone reusable Django package with tests, CI, pre-commit, and optional example project. Includes a separate cleanup sub-skill for wiring the package back into the original project.

plugins.name: django-run-site
plugins.description: Reference for working with a local Django dev stack managed by run-site (django-run-site) and django-dev-helpers — recognizing a run-site project, where the .run-site-config sidecar and .dev_helpers_* dotfiles live, reading the web/Postgres/Redis/SQLite endpoints and ports, autologin, and what the run-site CLI can do

plugins.name: github-build-fixer
plugins.description: Diagnoses and fixes failing GitHub Actions CI builds — reads logs, proposes fixes, pushes, polls until green

plugins.name: long-file-splitter
plugins.description: Scans a repo for oversized source files (Python, JS/TS, HTML, Vue/Svelte) above a line threshold, classifies why each one grew (grab-bag utils, god-class, mega-constant, mixed concerns), and produces a per-file split proposal with concrete module names and rationale — proposal-first, optional guided execution one file at a time

plugins.name: oss-github-publisher
plugins.description: Pre-flight audit before publishing a repo as open source — checks LICENSE, CI, pre-commit, scans for secrets and PII

plugins.name: premortem
plugins.description: Klein-style premortem on plans, launches, hires, pricing, or strategy — assumes failure 6 months out and works backward to expose blind spots

plugins.name: python-upgrade-package
plugins.description: Modernizes legacy Python packages step-by-step — setup.py to uv + pyproject.toml, Travis to GitHub Actions, pytest migration

plugins.name: python2-cleanup
plugins.description: Removes Python 2 compatibility cruft from a Py3 codebase — six, __future__, unicode()/basestring/xrange, python_2_unicode_compatible, iteritems, has_key, u'' prefix, __metaclass__, stdlib renames, dunder renames — category by category, one commit each

plugins.name: readme-guardian
plugins.description: Analyzes and improves Python project READMEs — badges, install instructions, version support matrix

plugins.name: freshdesk
plugins.description: Review of pending Freshdesk tickets (iplweb account) — fetches open tickets, ranks by composite priority (SLA → due date → priority → age), shows a readable list and drives action. Companion to ticket-resolver. iplweb-specific.

plugins.name: ticket-resolver
plugins.description: Handles a single support ticket end-to-end — from a Freshdesk (iplweb) or GitHub issue: triage (explain vs fix), draft a client reply for approval, or branch + worktree + TDD repro test + fix + PR + towncrier newsfragment, with internal trace notes. iplweb/BPP-specific.
